answer: Isotope fingerprinting of conduit water, like deuterium excess in basalt springs, lets an agent economy bind identity to a costly physical tracer that a gale of sybils cannot fake without real aquifer access. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
